items.title: 10.2 Trigonometric Ratios of Allied Angles (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle page (10.1.2) par aap ne kuch results dekhe the jin mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ya \(2\pi\) ke saath \(\theta\) jura hua tha, jaise \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - \beta\right) = \sin\beta\) aur \(\cos(2\pi - \theta) = \cos\theta\). Woh asal mein allied angles ki pehli jhalak thi. Aaj hum is khayal ko poora phailayenge.

Socho aap se koi poochhe:\(\sin 225^{\circ}\) kitna hai? Ya \(\tan 600^{\circ}\)? Itne bare angles ki values humein yaad nahin. Lekin is topic ke baad aap inhein chand second mein bata sakenge, kyun ke har bare angle ko ek chhote (acute) angle se jora ja sakta hai. Yahi allied angles ka kamaal hai.

Kitab ki definition: do angles \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) allied (aapas mein jure hue, rishtedaar) kehlate hain agar \(\alpha \pm \beta = n(90^{\circ})\), jahan \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\) (koi integer, yani poora number).
Misaal ke taur par \(\pm\alpha\), \(90^{\circ} \pm \alpha\), \(180^{\circ} \pm \alpha\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \alpha\) aur \(360^{\circ} \pm \alpha\), sab \(\alpha\) ke allied angles hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Aasan lafzon mein: do angles ka jama ya farq agar right angle (\(90^{\circ}\)) ka poora guna ho, to woh allied hain. Misaal: \(30^{\circ}\) aur \(60^{\circ}\) (jama \(90^{\circ}\)), \(30^{\circ}\) aur \(150^{\circ}\) (jama \(180^{\circ}\)), \(30^{\circ}\) aur \(210^{\circ}\) (farq \(180^{\circ}\)). Aise angles ke trigonometric ratios aapas mein gehra rishta rakhte hain: ya bilkul barabar hote hain, ya sirf sign ka farq, ya sin ki jagah cos aa jata hai. Is liye bare angle ka ratio chhote acute angle ke ratio se nikal aata hai.
Fundamental law \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\) aur us ke deductions (10.1.2) ki madad se yeh identities banti hain. Pehla group \(\frac{\pi}{2} \mp \theta\) ka:

\[\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cos\theta\]
\[\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \sin\theta\]
\[\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cot\theta\]
\[\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = \cos\theta\]
\[\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\sin\theta\]
\[\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\cot\theta\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is group mein \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = \sin\theta\) chhaapti hai, yani minus sign ghayab hai. Sahi \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\sin\theta\) hai, jo hum 10.1.2 ke result (ii) mein saabit kar chuke hain. Wajah: \(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\) Quadrant II mein hai, aur wahan cos negative hota hai. Upar hum ne sahi likha hai.

Doosra group \(\pi \mp \theta\) ka:
\[\sin(\pi-\theta) = \sin\theta\]
\[\cos(\pi-\theta) = -\cos\theta\]
\[\tan(\pi-\theta) = -\tan\theta\]
\[\sin(\pi+\theta) = -\sin\theta\]
\[\cos(\pi+\theta) = -\cos\theta\]
\[\tan(\pi+\theta) = \tan\theta\]

Teesra group \(\frac{3\pi}{2} \mp \theta\) ka:
\[\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = -\cos\theta\]
\[\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = -\sin\theta\]
\[\tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cot\theta\]
\[\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\cos\theta\]
\[\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = \sin\theta\]
\[\tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\cot\theta\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is group mein \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cos\theta\) chhaapti hai. Sahi \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = -\cos\theta\) hai, kyun ke \(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\) Quadrant III mein hai jahan sin negative hota hai. Kitab khud neeche part (a)(iii) mein \(-\cos\theta\) hi likhti hai.

Chautha group \(2\pi \mp \theta\) ka:
\[\sin(2\pi-\theta) = -\sin\theta\]
\[\cos(2\pi-\theta) = \cos\theta\]
\[\tan(2\pi-\theta) = -\tan\theta\]
\[\sin(2\pi+\theta) = \sin\theta\]
\[\cos(2\pi+\theta) = \cos\theta\]
\[\tan(2\pi+\theta) = \tan\theta\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Har line 10.1.2 ke formulas se saabit ho sakti hai. Misaal: \(\sin(\pi - \theta) = \sin\pi\cos\theta - \cos\pi\sin\theta = 0 - (-1)\sin\theta = \sin\theta\), kyun ke \(\sin\pi = 0\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\). Lekin ghabraiye mat, yeh 24 lines ratta lagane ki zaroorat nahin. Neeche kitab ek aisa tareeqa (device) deti hai jis se koi bhi line aap khud chand second mein bana lenge.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Upar wale results sine, cosine aur tangent ke reciprocals (ulte ratios: cosec, sec, cot) par bhi lagu hote hain. Yeh results trigonometry mein baar baar kaam aate hain, aur inhein neeche diye gaye tareeqe se yaad rakha ja sakta hai:

items: Agar \(\theta\) ko right angle ke odd multiple (taaq guna: 1, 3, 5 ... martaba \(90^{\circ}\)) mein jama ya us se tafreeq kiya jaye, to trigonometric ratio apne co-ratio mein badal jata hai, aur co-ratio wapas asal ratio mein: sin \(\rightleftarrows\) cos, tan \(\rightleftarrows\) cot, sec \(\rightleftarrows\) cosec. Misaal: \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cos\theta\) aur \(\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = \sin\theta\).
Agar \(\theta\) ko \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke even multiple (juft guna: 2, 4, 6 ... martaba) mein jama ya tafreeq kiya jaye, to ratio wahi ka wahi rehta hai.

Natije ka sign (plus ya minus) us quadrant se tay hota hai jis mein angle ka terminal arm (aakhri bazu) parta hai. Misaal: \(\sin(\pi-\theta) = \sin\theta\), \(\tan(\pi+\theta) = \tan\theta\), \(\cos(2\pi-\theta) = \cos\theta\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Ab is device ko chala kar dekhte hain, \(\cos(\pi + \theta)\) par. Qadam 1: \(\pi = 2 \times \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani even multiple, is liye cos, cos hi rahega. Qadam 2: \(\theta\) ko chhota acute angle samjhiye (jaise \(10^{\circ}\)); to \(\pi + \theta\) yani \(190^{\circ}\) Quadrant III mein hai. Qadam 3: Quadrant III mein cos negative hai. Natija: \(\cos(\pi + \theta) = -\cos\theta\).\nDhyan dein: θ ko acute maanna sirf sign tay karne ka tareeqa hai; identities θ ki har value ke liye sach hain.
Kaun sa angle kis quadrant mein parta hai, yeh kitab ka table batata hai (θ acute maan kar). Saath wala chart batata hai ke kis quadrant mein kaun sa ratio positive hai:

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Chart ko Quadrant I se anticlockwise (ghari ki ulti simt) A, S, T, C yaad kariye: “All Students Take Coffee”. I mein All (sab) positive, II mein Sin (aur cosec), III mein Tan (aur cot), IV mein Cos (aur sec). Baqi ratios us quadrant mein negative hote hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh signs aate kahan se hain? Unit circle yaad kijiye: point \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) hota hai, yani cos \(x\)-coordinate hai aur sin \(y\)-coordinate. Quadrant I mein \(x\) aur \(y\) dono positive, is liye sab positive. Quadrant II mein \(x\) negative magar \(y\) positive, is liye sirf sin positive. Quadrant III mein dono negative; sin aur cos negative, lekin tan \(= \frac{y}{x}\) mein do negative mil kar positive ho jaate hain. Quadrant IV mein \(x\) positive, \(y\) negative, is liye sirf cos positive. Yani chart ratta lagane ki cheez nahin, yeh coordinates ke signs se khud ban jata hai. Reciprocal ratios (cosec, sec, cot) ka sign hamesha apne asal ratio (sin, cos, tan) jaisa hota hai.

(a) \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\), \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right)\), \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\) aur \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right)\) mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke odd multiples hain (1 aur 3 guna). Is liye sin badal kar cos ban jayega. Ab sign dekhte hain:

items: (i) \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\) ka terminal side Quad. I mein hai, is liye \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = \cos\theta\);
(ii) \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right)\) ka terminal side Quad. II mein hai (wahan sin positive), is liye \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = \cos\theta\);
(iii) \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\) ka terminal side Quad. III mein hai (wahan sin negative), is liye \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = -\cos\theta\);
(iv) \(\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right)\) ka terminal side Quad. IV mein hai (wahan sin negative), is liye \(\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}+\theta\right) = -\cos\theta\).

blocks.text: (b) \(\cos(\pi-\theta)\), \(\cos(\pi+\theta)\), \(\cos(2\pi-\theta)\) aur \(\cos(2\pi+\theta)\) mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke even multiples hain (2 aur 4 guna). Is liye cos, cos hi rahega. Ab sign:

items: (i) \((\pi-\theta)\) ka terminal side Quad. II mein hai (cos negative), is liye \(\cos(\pi-\theta) = -\cos\theta\);
(ii) \((\pi+\theta)\) ka terminal side Quad. III mein hai (cos negative), is liye \(\cos(\pi+\theta) = -\cos\theta\);
(iii) \((2\pi-\theta)\) ka terminal side Quad. IV mein hai (cos positive), is liye \(\cos(2\pi-\theta) = \cos\theta\);
(iv) \((2\pi+\theta)\) ka terminal side Quad. I mein hai (sab positive), is liye \(\cos(2\pi+\theta) = \cos\theta\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Negative angle ho to pehle minus bahar nikaaliye: \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\), \(\tan(-\theta) = -\tan\theta\), \(\cot(-\theta) = -\cot\theta\), \(\operatorname{cosec}(-\theta) = -\operatorname{cosec}\theta\). Lekin \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\) aur \(\sec(-\theta) = \sec\theta\): yeh do minus ko nigal jaate hain. Phir positive angle par device lagaiye. Example 3 ke hisse (iii) aur (iv) mein yahi hoga.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem:
Without using the tables, write down the values of:
(i) \(\sin 225^{\circ}\)  (ii) \(\tan 600^{\circ}\)  (iii) \(\cot(-225^{\circ})\)  (iv) \(\operatorname{cosec}(-420^{\circ})\)
steps:
Given: angles \(225^{\circ}\), \(600^{\circ}\), \(-225^{\circ}\) aur \(-420^{\circ}\).
To find: har ratio ki exact value, tables ke baghair.
Method: har angle ko \(n \times 90^{\circ} \pm \theta\) ki shakal mein likhiye, jahan \(\theta\) acute ho. \(n\) even ho to ratio wahi, odd ho to co-ratio. Sign us ASAL ratio ka jo poora angle wale quadrant mein hai. Negative angle ho to pehle minus bahar.

(i) sin 225°
\[\sin 225^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} + 45^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin(2 \times 90^{\circ} + 45^{\circ})\]
\[= -\sin 45^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: \(n = 2\) even hai, is liye sin, sin hi raha. \(225^{\circ}\), \(180^{\circ}\) aur \(270^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan hai, yani Quadrant III, jahan sin negative hai. Is liye minus aaya. Yaad rakhiye, \(45^{\circ}\) par sin ki value \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) hai; device ne humein sirf yeh bataya ke kaun sa ratio lena hai aur sign kya lagana hai, value hamesha acute angle wali hi hoti hai.

(ii) tan 600°
\[\tan 600^{\circ} = \tan(540^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= \tan(6 \times 90^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= \tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(540^{\circ} = 6 \times 90^{\circ}\), \(n = 6\) even, is liye tan, tan raha. Quadrant kaise dhoondein? \(600^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} + 240^{\circ}\): ek poora chakkar laga kar \(240^{\circ}\) par ruke, jo Quadrant III hai. Wahan tan positive hai, is liye plus.

(iii) cot(−225°)
\[\cot(-225^{\circ}) = -\cot 225^{\circ}\]
\[= -\cot(180^{\circ} + 45^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cot(2 \times 90^{\circ} + 45^{\circ})\]
\[= -\cot 45^{\circ} = -1\]
Kyun: pehle minus bahar, kyun ke \(\cot(-\theta) = -\cot\theta\). Phir \(180^{\circ} = 2 \times 90^{\circ}\), even, is liye cot, cot raha. \(225^{\circ}\) Quadrant III mein hai, jahan tan aur cot dono positive hain, yani \(\cot 225^{\circ} = +\cot 45^{\circ} = 1\). Aagay wala minus lagane se jawab \(-1\).
Dhyan dein: bahar wala minus aur quadrant wala sign do alag cheezein hain; dono ko alag alag tay kariye.

(iv) cosec(−420°)
\[\operatorname{cosec}(-420^{\circ}) = -\operatorname{cosec} 420^{\circ}\]
\[= -\operatorname{cosec}(360^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= -\operatorname{cosec}(4 \times 90^{\circ} + 60^{\circ})\]
\[= -\operatorname{cosec} 60^{\circ} = -\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\operatorname{cosec}(-\theta) = -\operatorname{cosec}\theta\), is liye minus bahar. \(360^{\circ} = 4 \times 90^{\circ}\), even, is liye cosec raha. \(420^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} + 60^{\circ}\) Quadrant I mein hai, jahan sab positive: \(\operatorname{cosec} 420^{\circ} = \operatorname{cosec} 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sin 60^{\circ}} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\). Bahar wala minus qaim rehta hai.

Tasdeeq: poora period ghata kar dobara dekhte hain
(i) Calculator: \(\sin 225^{\circ} \approx -0.7071\), aur \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx -0.7071\).
(ii) tan har \(180^{\circ}\) baad dohraata hai: \(\tan 600^{\circ} = \tan(600^{\circ} - 540^{\circ}) = \tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\).
(iii) cot bhi har \(180^{\circ}\) baad: \(\cot(-225^{\circ}) = \cot(-225^{\circ} + 180^{\circ}) = \cot(-45^{\circ}) = -1\).
(iv) cosec har \(360^{\circ}\) baad: \(\operatorname{cosec}(-420^{\circ}) = \operatorname{cosec}(-60^{\circ}) = -\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\). Chaaron jawab pakke.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
(iii) Kitab chhaapti hai: \(-\cot(180 + 45)^{\circ} = -\cot(4\times 90+45)^{\circ} = -(-\cot 45^{\circ}) = 1\). Is mein do ghaltiyan hain: \(180^{\circ} = 2 \times 90^{\circ}\) hai, \(4 \times 90^{\circ}\) nahin; aur Quadrant III mein cot positive hota hai, is liye \(\cot 225^{\circ} = +\cot 45^{\circ}\). Sahi jawab \(\cot(-225^{\circ}) = -1\) hai.
(iv) Kitab aakhir mein \(-\operatorname{cosec} 60^{\circ} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) likhti hai, minus sign gira deti hai. Sahi: \(\operatorname{cosec}(-420^{\circ}) = -\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\).

blocks.title: Example 4
steps:
Given: chhe (6) allied-angle ratios ka ek fraction.
To find: is ki sab se saada shakal, \(\theta\) mein.
Method: sab se pehle har ratio ko alag alag device se \(\theta\) ke ratio mein badalenge (odd/even multiple, phir quadrant se sign), phir fraction mein rakh kar common cheezein cut karenge. Ek saath sab karne ki koshish mein ghalti hoti hai; ek ek kar ke chaliye.

Step 1: Numerator ke ratios
\[\sin(180^{\circ}-\theta) = \sin\theta\]
\[\cos(360^{\circ}-\theta) = \cos\theta\]
\[\tan(90^{\circ}+\theta) = -\cot\theta\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) aur \(360^{\circ}\) even multiples hain, is liye sin aur cos wahi rahe; \(180^{\circ}-\theta\) Quadrant II mein (sin positive), \(360^{\circ}-\theta\) Quadrant IV mein (cos positive). \(90^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, is liye tan badal kar cot bana; \(90^{\circ}+\theta\) Quadrant II mein hai jahan tan negative hai, is liye minus.

Step 2: Denominator ke ratios
\[\sin(90^{\circ}-\theta) = \cos\theta\]
\[\cos(180^{\circ}+\theta) = -\cos\theta\]
\[\tan(270^{\circ}+\theta) = -\cot\theta\]
Kyun: \(90^{\circ}-\theta\): odd, sin se cos, Quadrant I, positive. \(180^{\circ}+\theta\): even, cos raha, Quadrant III, negative. \(270^{\circ} = 3 \times 90^{\circ}\) odd hai, is liye tan se cot bana; aur \(270^{\circ}+\theta\) Quadrant IV mein hai jahan tan negative hai. Is liye \(-\cot\theta\).
Dhyan dein: sign hamesha ASAL ratio (yahan tan) ka dekha jata hai, naye ratio (cot) ka nahin. Kitab yahin phisal gayi hai (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).

Step 3: Values rakhein
\[\dfrac{\sin\theta\cdot\cos\theta\cdot(-\cot\theta)}{\cos\theta\cdot(-\cos\theta)\cdot(-\cot\theta)}\]
Kyun: Step 1 aur 2 ki har value apni jagah rakh di. Ab sirf algebra baqi hai. Ghor kariye ke numerator mein ek minus hai aur denominator mein do; signs ko alag se gin lena sab se mehfooz tareeqa hai: upar ek minus, neeche do minus jo mil kar plus ban jaate hain, to aakhri jawab mein ek hi minus bachega.

Step 4: Simplify karein
\[= \dfrac{-\sin\theta\cos\theta\cot\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta\cot\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = -\tan\theta\]
Kyun: denominator mein do minus hain: \((-\cos\theta)(-\cot\theta) = +\cos\theta\cot\theta\), minus minus plus. Phir \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\cot\theta\) upar neeche dono jagah hain, cut ho gaye. Bacha \(\frac{-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\), aur \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) rakh kar
\[\text{Num.} = \sin 150^{\circ}\cos 330^{\circ}\tan 120^{\circ}\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot(-\sqrt{3}) = -\tfrac{3}{4}\]
\[\text{Den.} = \sin 60^{\circ}\cos 210^{\circ}\tan 300^{\circ}\]
\[= \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\left(-\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\cdot(-\sqrt{3}) = \tfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}\]
\[\text{Num.} \div \text{Den.} = -\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = -\tan 30^{\circ}\]
Numbers bhi \(-\tan\theta\) hi dete hain, \(\tan\theta\) nahin. Jawab pakka.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab \(\tan(270^{\circ}+\theta) = \cot\theta\) chhaapti hai. Sahi \(\tan(270^{\circ}+\theta) = -\cot\theta\) hai (odd multiple, tan se cot; Quadrant IV mein tan negative), aur kitab ke apne identities wale group mein bhi yahi likha hai. Is sign ke saath denominator \(\cos^{2}\theta\cot\theta\) banta hai aur jawab \(-\tan\theta\) aata hai. Kitab ka aakhri jawab \(\tan\theta\) ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin: \(\cos 300^{\circ}\) nikaaliye.
\(300^{\circ} = 270^{\circ} + 30^{\circ} = 3 \times 90^{\circ} + 30^{\circ}\): odd multiple, is liye cos badal kar sin.
\(300^{\circ}\) Quadrant IV mein hai, wahan cos positive. To \(\cos 300^{\circ} = +\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\).
Doosre raste se: \(300^{\circ} = 360^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}\), even, cos raha, Quadrant IV positive: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Dono raste ek hi manzil par!

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek aur practice, is dafa reciprocal ratio ke saath (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(\sec 240^{\circ}\) nikaaliye.
\(240^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} + 60^{\circ} = 2 \times 90^{\circ} + 60^{\circ}\): even multiple, is liye sec, sec hi rahega.
\(240^{\circ}\) Quadrant III mein hai. Wahan cos negative hai, is liye us ka reciprocal sec bhi negative.
\(\sec 240^{\circ} = -\sec 60^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{\cos 60^{\circ}} = -2\).
Tasdeeq: \(\cos 240^{\circ} = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\), aur \(\frac{1}{-1/2} = -2\). Sahi! Is se yeh bhi pakka hua ke Note wali baat, yani results reciprocals par bhi lagte hain, sach hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\sin 150^{\circ}\) aur \(\tan 135^{\circ}\) zehan mein nikaaliye. (Jawab: \(\sin 150^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}) = \frac{1}{2}\); \(\tan 135^{\circ} = \tan(180^{\circ} - 45^{\circ}) = -1\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Allied angles: \(\alpha \pm \beta = n(90^{\circ})\); jaise \(90^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(180^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(270^{\circ} \pm \theta\), \(360^{\circ} \pm \theta\).
2. \(90^{\circ}\) ka odd multiple: sin \(\leftrightarrow\) cos, tan \(\leftrightarrow\) cot, sec \(\leftrightarrow\) cosec. Even multiple: ratio wahi.
3. Sign ASAL ratio ka, poore angle ke quadrant mein (θ ko acute maan kar).
4. Quadrants: I mein All, II mein Sin, III mein Tan, IV mein Cos positive (All Students Take Coffee).
5. Negative angle: pehle minus bahar; cos aur sec minus ko nigal jaate hain, baqi chaar minus bahar nikaalte hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sign naye ratio se lena. \(\tan(270^{\circ}+\theta)\) mein sign tan ka Quadrant IV mein dekha jata hai (negative), chahe jawab cot mein likha jaye: \(-\cot\theta\). Kitab ki Example 4 wali ghalti yahi hai.
2. Multiple ghalat ginna: \(180^{\circ} = 2 \times 90^{\circ}\) (even), \(270^{\circ} = 3 \times 90^{\circ}\) (odd), \(540^{\circ} = 6 \times 90^{\circ}\) (even).
3. Negative angle se bahar nikala hua minus aakhir tak le jana bhool jana, jaise kitab ki Example 3 (iv) mein hua.
4. \(360^{\circ}\) se bare angle ka quadrant dhoondte waqt pehle poore chakkar (\(360^{\circ}\)) na ghatana.
